sections.title: The letter capa
paragraphs: The letter is named (capa) /ˈkapɐ/. It usually makes the sound heard in (kilo) /ˈki.lu/, a unit of weight. This letter has one sound.

sections.title: Mouth and air
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Block the air flow completely. Release the air suddenly without any voice. Touch your throat to confirm that your vocal cords do not vibrate.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter appears in loanwords and international scientific symbols. It always represents the sound heard in (kit) /ˈkit/ and in (karting) /ˈkaɾ.tĩŋ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not release a puff of breath after this sound. Hold the air cleanly like the c in skin, never like the c in cat.
